detailed_summary.async_only: One measured A100 120000x8 run preserved the 5.8125 GiB block cache and 41960 MiB peak process memory while decode throughput was 200.817331 tok/s versus the canonical baseline mean 198.836414 tok/s. This is a one-round measured result, not a generalized speed claim.
detailed_summary.low6_async: One measured A100 120000x8 run preserved low6 block-cache memory at 5.540039 GiB and peak process memory at 41672 MiB; decode throughput was 199.402850 tok/s versus baseline mean 198.836414 tok/s and low6 validation mean 196.092034 tok/s. Computed e2e generated throughput was slightly below the baseline/low6 references, so the supported result is memory plus decode improvement, not an end-to-end speedup.

summary: Implemented a default-off Python async cluster-id D2H copy path and measured two A100 120000x8/cache_ratio=0.05 candidates. async-only passed correctness with returncode 0 and RETROINFER_OUTPUT_JSON.all_outputs_contain_groundtruth=true, kept block cache at 5.8125 GiB and peak process GPU memory at 41960 MiB, and measured 200.817331 decode tok/s versus the canonical baseline mean 198.836414. low6+async passed correctness with returncode 0 and the same oracle, kept low6 block cache at 5.540039 GiB and peak process GPU memory at 41672 MiB, and measured 199.402850 decode tok/s versus baseline mean 198.836414 and low6 validation mean 196.092034. Computed e2e generated throughput for low6+async is slightly below the baseline/low6 references, so the supported claim is limited to measured memory preservation/savings plus decode improvement, not a generalized or profiler-level end-to-end speedup.
